/usr/bin/prlimit --core=0:0 -- /usr/bin/python3 -B - <<'PY'
import ast, hashlib, importlib.util, json
from pathlib import Path
old_path = Path('/lustrefs/users/chufan.shi/codex_space_tn/publication/k3_formal_outer_evidence_candidate_v1/prepare_metadata.py')
new_path = Path('/lustrefs/users/chufan.shi/codex_space_tn/publication/glm_full_outer_evidence_candidate_v1/prepare_metadata.py')
old_raw, new_raw = old_path.read_bytes(), new_path.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(old_raw).hexdigest() == 'cd6e38d33b0230a394a06f6b99df34b9176a0e11ffe6553039ddc21025f9e72e'
old_ast, new_ast = ast.parse(old_raw), ast.parse(new_raw)
old_f = {n.name:n for n in old_ast.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}
new_f = {n.name:n for n in new_ast.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)}
assert set(old_f) == set(new_f)
for name in set(old_f) - {'main'}:
    assert ast.get_source_segment(old_raw.decode(), old_f[name]) == ast.get_source_segment(new_raw.decode(), new_f[name]), name
changes = []
def compare(a,b,path='main'):
    if isinstance(a,ast.Constant) and isinstance(b,ast.Constant):
        if type(a.value) is not type(b.value) or a.value != b.value: changes.append([path,a.value,b.value])
        return
    assert type(a) is type(b), path
    if isinstance(a,ast.AST):
        for field in a._fields: compare(getattr(a,field),getattr(b,field),path+'.'+field)
    elif isinstance(a,list):
        assert len(a)==len(b),path
        for i,(left,right) in enumerate(zip(a,b)): compare(left,right,path+'[%d]'%i)
    else: assert a==b,path
compare(old_f['main'],new_f['main'])
assert len(changes)==6,changes
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('outer_cpu_static',new_path)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
paths=[p for values in m.groups.values() for p in values]
assert len(paths)==len(set(paths))==668
assert len(m.PINS)==54 and set(m.PINS)<=set(paths)
assert len(m.groups['raw_batch_proofs'])==396
assert len(m.groups['raw_scan_outputs'])==182
assert len(m.groups['raw_scope_candidates'])==39
assert all(len(h)==64 and set(h)<=set('0123456789abcdef') for h in m.PINS.values())
assert all('/glm_public_controls_subset_v1/' in str(p) for p in m.groups['controls_public_scope'])
assert not any(p.name=='invocation.json' or str(p).endswith('.tar.gz') or '/restore/payload/' in str(p) or '/restored/payload/' in str(p) for p in paths)
assert not (new_path.parent/'FILES.candidate.json').exists()
assert not (new_path.parent/'HASH_RECEIPT.json').exists()
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'static_only':True,'candidate_source_ref':{'path':str(new_path),'bytes':len(new_raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(new_raw).hexdigest()},'source_ref':{'path':str(old_path),'bytes':len(old_raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(old_raw).hexdigest()},'function_names':sorted(old_f),'non_main_functions_byte_identical':True,'main_ast_structure_identical':True,'main_constant_deltas':changes,'scope_count':len(paths),'external_pin_count':len(m.PINS),'groups':{k:len(v) for k,v in m.groups.items()},'real_metadata_main_executed':False,'input_metadata_or_payload_or_key_hashes':0},sort_keys=True))
